fields.name: place_id
fields.description: Stable identifier. Never reused. Does not count.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Schema version. Does not count.

fields.name: protocol_version
fields.description: Measurement protocol version. Does not count.

fields.name: record_version
fields.description: Increments on each published change. Does not count.

fields.name: record_status
fields.description: draft, in_review, published, stale_flagged, archived, or disputed. Does not count.

fields.name: name_en
fields.description: Official English name as published by the venue or operator.

fields.name: name_fr
fields.description: Official French name where it exists. A translation of name_en does not add a second piece.

fields.name: former_names
fields.description: Former names with dates. One piece when the array is populated.

fields.name: also_known_as
fields.description: Search aliases. One piece when populated.

fields.name: category_primary
fields.description: Primary category as published. The controlled list is versioned and is not closed in this schema, because the plan does not publish the list and a closed list would force relabelled categories.

fields.name: category_secondary
fields.description: Secondary categories. One piece when populated.

fields.name: place_type
fields.description: Place type from the plan. Not inferred from an amenity tag during migration.

fields.name: address_street
fields.description: Street address, including unit where it is already one published string.

fields.name: address_city
fields.description: City, town, or community name.

fields.name: municipality_lower_tier
fields.description: Lower-tier municipality where applicable.

fields.name: municipality_upper_tier
fields.description: Upper-tier municipality or region where applicable.

fields.name: postal_code
fields.description: Postal code as published.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude in WGS84 decimal degrees.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude in WGS84 decimal degrees.

fields.name: location_accuracy_m
fields.description: Estimated accuracy in metres, with method.

fields.name: geocode_source
fields.description: How the coordinate was obtained.

fields.name: geocode_date
fields.description: Date the location was determined or last checked.

fields.name: phone_main
fields.description: Main public phone number.

fields.name: phone_accessibility
fields.description: Accessibility or assistance phone, where published separately.

fields.name: email_public
fields.description: Public email address.

fields.name: website_url
fields.description: Official website.

fields.name: accessibility_page_url
fields.description: Venue accessibility page, where published.

fields.name: hours_general
fields.description: General opening hours as published.

fields.name: hours_accessibility_note
fields.description: Hours that differ for the accessible entrance or route.

fields.name: admission_cost
fields.description: Admission cost or free status as published. Not pricing advice.

fields.name: booking_required
fields.description: Whether booking or advance notice is required.

fields.name: booking_details
fields.description: Booking method and lead time where booking is required.

fields.name: general_access_summary
fields.description: Factual summary written from measurements. Not a bare accessible label.

fields.name: step_free_route_exists
fields.description: Whether a step-free route to the main activity was observed. Never assumed.

fields.name: step_free_route_description
fields.description: Description of the step-free route, including a side or rear entrance where that is the route.

fields.name: accessible_entrance_location
fields.description: Where the step-free entrance is relative to the street and the main entrance.

fields.name: entrance_count_total
fields.description: Count of public entrances observed.

fields.name: entrance_count_step_free
fields.description: Count of step-free public entrances observed.

fields.name: lift_or_elevator_present
fields.description: Whether a lift or elevator serves public areas.

fields.name: lift_or_elevator_details
fields.description: Lift location, floors served, and operator. Elevator assets are separate records.

fields.name: platform_lift_present
fields.description: Whether a platform lift was observed.

fields.name: ramp_present_general
fields.description: Whether a ramp serves the main access route. Ramp measurements live on the entrance.

fields.name: interior_path_min_width_mm
fields.description: Minimum clear interior path width, measured.

fields.name: interior_turning_space_mm
fields.description: Clear turning diameter in key interior areas, measured.

fields.name: interior_floor_surface
fields.description: Primary interior floor surface as observed.

fields.name: interior_floor_obstructions
fields.description: Recurring obstructions as observed.

fields.name: seating_available
fields.description: Whether seating is available in public areas.

fields.name: seating_types
fields.description: Seating types, armrests, back support, and space for a wheelchair alongside.

fields.name: wheelchair_spaces_count
fields.description: Designated wheelchair spaces as observed or as published.

fields.name: wheelchair_spaces_location
fields.description: Location and sightline note for wheelchair spaces.

fields.name: counter_heights_mm
fields.description: Service counter heights in millimetres, including a lowered section where present.

fields.name: counter_knee_clearance
fields.description: Knee clearance at a lowered counter, height and depth, measured.

fields.name: till_or_service_desk_access
fields.description: Access note for tills, desks, and reception, including the queue.

fields.name: changing_facilities_general
fields.description: General changing note. Adult change and hoist fields live on the washroom.

fields.name: baby_change_present
fields.description: Baby changing, distinct from an adult change table.

fields.name: hearing_loop_present
fields.description: Hearing loop or assistive listening as observed or published.

fields.name: hearing_loop_locations
fields.description: Where the hearing loop works and how to request it.

fields.name: signage_braille_tactile
fields.description: Braille or tactile signage observed.

fields.name: signage_visual_contrast
fields.description: Visual signage contrast, size, and placement as observed.

fields.name: lighting_general
fields.description: Lighting note. No invented lux value.

fields.name: noise_level_general
fields.description: Noise note. No decibel claim without a measurement.

fields.name: quiet_space_available
fields.description: Quiet or low-stimulation space as observed or published.

fields.name: scent_free_policy
fields.description: Scent policy as published, with its own source and date on the fact.

fields.name: service_animal_policy
fields.description: Service-animal policy as published for this place. Not generalised.

fields.name: support_person_policy_place
fields.description: Support-person admission or fare policy as published for this place.

fields.name: accessible_format_available
fields.description: Accessible formats and how to request them, as published.

fields.name: asl_lsq_available
fields.description: ASL or LSQ interpretation as published, including lead time.

fields.name: french_service_available
fields.description: French-language service as published or designated. Not machine-translated.

fields.name: staff_assistance_available
fields.description: Staff assistance and how to request it.

fields.name: queue_management
fields.description: Queue layout, accessible queue route, and seating while waiting.

fields.name: emergency_procedure_note
fields.description: Evacuation note as published by the venue. The App does not invent a procedure.

fields.name: emergency_exit_access
fields.description: Emergency exit access as observed or published.

fields.name: charging_available_general
fields.description: Whether device or power-chair charging is available. Detail lives on a charging record.

fields.name: charging_details_general
fields.description: Charging location, permission, and hours where charging is available.

fields.name: wifi_available
fields.description: Public Wi-Fi as published.

fields.name: drinking_water_available
fields.description: Drinking water or a bottle-filling station as observed.

fields.name: outdoor_areas_access
fields.description: Outdoor path, seating, shade, and shelter note.

fields.name: trail_access_summary
fields.description: Trail summary for parks and trailheads. Segment records hold the measured parts.

fields.name: construction_or_disruption_note
fields.description: Construction or closure note with its own expiry on the fact.

fields.name: winter_access_note
fields.description: Snow, ice, and seasonal entrance changes. A summer note is not a winter verification.

fields.name: build_or_renovation_year
fields.description: Build or last major renovation year where known. Context only, not a compliance label.

fields.name: code_version_context
fields.description: Code-version context where known. Never a compliance label.

fields.name: rhfac_or_certification_note
fields.description: Voluntary certification note where published. Distinct from a code-compliance claim.

fields.name: accessibility_plan_url
fields.description: Multi-year accessibility plan where the venue publishes one.

fields.name: feedback_process
fields.description: Venue accessibility feedback process as published.

fields.name: photo_evidence_summary
fields.description: Computed from photograph records. Does not count.

fields.name: linked_entrance_ids
fields.description: Entrance record ids. Does not count.

fields.name: linked_washroom_ids
fields.description: Washroom record ids. Does not count.

fields.name: linked_parking_ids
fields.description: Parking record ids. Does not count.

fields.name: linked_segment_ids
fields.description: Approach segment ids. Does not count.

fields.name: linked_transit_stop_ids
fields.description: Transit stop ids. Does not count.

fields.name: source_primary
fields.description: Primary source id. Provenance, not a data piece. source_name is the display name.

fields.name: source_date
fields.description: Date of the primary source. Provenance, not a data piece.

fields.name: verification_tier_summary
fields.description: Optional computed summary. The stored field tiers are authoritative. Does not count.

fields.name: last_verified_date
fields.description: Optional computed date. Does not count.

fields.name: verification_method_summary
fields.description: Optional computed method summary. Does not count.

fields.name: stale_flag
fields.description: Optional computed stale flag. Freshness is evaluated by the counter. Does not count.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Creation timestamp. Does not count.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Modification timestamp. Does not count.

fields.name: created_by_role
fields.description: Creator role only. No personal identifier. Does not count.

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Stable entrance id. Does not count.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Schema version. Does not count.

fields.name: place_id
fields.description: Parent place id. A reference, not a data piece.

fields.name: record_status
fields.description: Publication status. Does not count.

fields.name: entrance_name
fields.description: Name such as main, north, rear, or parking level.

fields.name: entrance_type
fields.description: Which kind of entrance this is.

fields.name: is_primary_public_entrance
fields.description: Whether this is the primary public entrance.

fields.name: step_free
fields.description: Step-free status as observed. Never assumed from a missing step count.

fields.name: step_count
fields.description: Observed step count. Zero is a recorded observation only when method and date are present.

fields.name: step_height_max_mm
fields.description: Largest single step, tread to tread, at the centre.

fields.name: threshold_height_mm
fields.description: Highest threshold, including a weather bar.

fields.name: door_clear_width_mm
fields.description: Clear opening with the door at 90 degrees, excluding door thickness and hardware.

fields.name: door_type
fields.description: Door type as observed.

fields.name: door_operator_present
fields.description: Power or automatic operator observed.

fields.name: door_operator_working
fields.description: Operator working on the verification date. Presence is not working status.

fields.name: door_opening_force_note
fields.description: Observed heavy, moderate, or light, with the method note. No invented Newton value.

fields.name: door_swing
fields.description: Door swing as observed.

fields.name: ramp_present
fields.description: Ramp present at this entrance.

fields.name: ramp_gradient_ratio
fields.description: Ratio computed from recorded rise and run. A ratio alone is not accepted as a measurement.

fields.name: ramp_rise_mm
fields.description: Total rise, bottom to top, measured.

fields.name: ramp_run_mm
fields.description: Total run, measured.

fields.name: ramp_length_mm
fields.description: Total length including landings.

fields.name: ramp_clear_width_mm
fields.description: Clear width between handrails at the narrowest point.

fields.name: ramp_landing_top_mm
fields.description: Top landing length and width, clear of the door swing.

fields.name: ramp_landing_bottom_mm
fields.description: Bottom landing length and width, clear of obstructions.

fields.name: ramp_handrails
fields.description: Handrails as observed.

fields.name: ramp_surface
fields.description: Ramp surface with slip and drainage note.

fields.name: approach_surface
fields.description: Approach surface and condition.

fields.name: approach_width_min_mm
fields.description: Narrowest clear approach width, excluding obstructions at the time of verification.

fields.name: approach_gradient_note
fields.description: Gradient observations on the approach. Not a computed slope from a map.

fields.name: lighting_note
fields.description: Lighting at the entrance as observed.

fields.name: signage_note
fields.description: Directions from the street and accessible-entrance signage.

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Stable washroom id. Does not count.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Schema version. Does not count.

fields.name: place_id
fields.description: Parent place id. A reference, not a data piece.

fields.name: record_status
fields.description: Publication status. Does not count.

fields.name: name_en
fields.description: Name as published by the source. A washroom that is its own open-data record may have no parent place.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude in WGS84 when the source publishes a point.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude in WGS84 when the source publishes a point.

fields.name: washroom_name
fields.description: Name such as universal washroom, ground floor, near lobby.

fields.name: washroom_type
fields.description: Washroom type. Standard means no accessibility features were observed, which is a fact, not a gap.

fields.name: location_description
fields.description: Floor, wing, and directions from the entrance.

fields.name: floor_level
fields.description: Floor, with a lift-access note where one was observed.

fields.name: route_to_washroom_note
fields.description: Step-free route, including stairs, lifts, or narrow points that were observed.

fields.name: door_clear_width_mm
fields.description: Washroom door clear width. Counted on the washroom, not on the entrance.

fields.name: door_operator_present
fields.description: Door operator present.

fields.name: door_operator_working
fields.description: Door operator working on the verification date.

fields.name: door_swing
fields.description: Door swing.

fields.name: door_lock_type
fields.description: Lock type. A lock without the access process is not a usable access fact on its own.

fields.name: door_lock_details
fields.description: Where the key is, how the code is published, staff-assist method, and hours when locked.

fields.name: turning_space_diameter_mm
fields.description: Clear turning diameter excluding the door swing and fixtures.

fields.name: turning_space_shape_note
fields.description: Shape, obstructions, and door-swing intrusion.

fields.name: transfer_side
fields.description: Transfer side. unknown_recorded counts only as a tri-state observation with method and date. none means no clear transfer space.

fields.name: transfer_space_width_mm
fields.description: Clear transfer-space width beside the toilet.

fields.name: transfer_space_depth_mm
fields.description: Clear transfer-space depth.

fields.name: toilet_seat_height_mm
fields.description: Floor to top of seat.

fields.name: toilet_type
fields.description: Toilet type as observed.

fields.name: grab_bar_left
fields.description: Left grab bar present.

fields.name: grab_bar_right
fields.description: Right grab bar present.

fields.name: grab_bar_rear
fields.description: Rear grab bar present.

fields.name: grab_bar_details
fields.description: Lengths, heights, diameters, folding or fixed, as observed. No invented dimensions.

fields.name: sink_height_mm
fields.description: Sink rim height.

fields.name: sink_knee_clearance_mm
fields.description: Clearance height under the sink.

fields.name: sink_tap_type
fields.description: Tap operation.

fields.name: mirror_height_note
fields.description: Mirror bottom height and whether it is usable from a seated position.

fields.name: shelf_and_hook_present
fields.description: Shelf and hook for bags and supplies.

fields.name: shelf_and_hook_details
fields.description: Shelf and hook heights and locations.

fields.name: emergency_call_present
fields.description: Emergency cord or button present. Do not test emergency systems without permission.

fields.name: emergency_call_reach_note
fields.description: Cord length and reach from the floor and from the toilet, as observed.

fields.name: privacy_note
fields.description: Door privacy, gaps, and attendant space.

fields.name: attendant_space_present
fields.description: Space for an attendant inside the washroom.

fields.name: adult_change_table_present
fields.description: Adult change table. Distinct from baby changing.

fields.name: adult_change_table_dimensions
fields.description: Length, width, and height range, measured or read from a label. Do not invent a size.

fields.name: adult_change_table_load_kg
fields.description: Rated load as labelled or published. Do not guess a load.

fields.name: adult_change_table_type
fields.description: Adult change table type.

fields.name: hoist_present
fields.description: Hoist present. Presence is not a claim that it is working or that a sling is provided.

fields.name: hoist_type
fields.description: Hoist type. none is a recorded absence, not an unknown.

fields.name: hoist_sling_policy
fields.description: Bring-your-own sling, sling provided, and sling type, as published or observed. Quoted, not paraphrased into advice.

fields.name: hoist_details
fields.description: Track coverage, labelled load, operation, and whether staff assistance is required.

fields.name: lighting_note
fields.description: Lighting as observed.

fields.name: flooring_note
fields.description: Surface, slip, and drainage as observed.

fields.name: cleanliness_and_maintenance_note
fields.description: Condition on the verification date.

fields.name: reliability_note
fields.description: Known outages, storage use, or blockages, with dates.

fields.name: hours_available
fields.description: Hours the washroom is available when they differ from the place hours.

fields.name: access_restriction_note
fields.description: Customers only, key, staff only, or fee, with source and date.

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Stable parking id. Does not count.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Schema version. Does not count.

fields.name: place_id
fields.description: Parent place id. A reference, not a data piece.

fields.name: record_status
fields.description: Publication status. Does not count.

fields.name: record_level
fields.description: Lot, bay, or bay group. Usability claims need bay-level records.

fields.name: lot_name
fields.description: Lot or garage name as published.

fields.name: operator_name
fields.description: Operator. Required in practice for a private-lot privilege claim.

fields.name: lot_access
fields.description: Whether the lot is municipal or private. A private rule is not stated as a municipal bylaw.

fields.name: bay_identifier
fields.description: Bay number or label where it exists.

fields.name: bay_type
fields.description: Bay type. Type A is van-accessible. unknown_recorded is not a van-accessible claim.

fields.name: bay_width_mm
fields.description: Bay width measured.

fields.name: bay_length_mm
fields.description: Bay length measured.

fields.name: access_aisle_width_mm
fields.description: Access aisle width. Zero only when the absence of an aisle was observed and recorded with method and date.

fields.name: access_aisle_side
fields.description: Which side the access aisle is on.

fields.name: surface_type
fields.description: Surface type and condition.

fields.name: surface_gradient_note
fields.description: Gradient observations. Not a guessed percent.

fields.name: signage_present
fields.description: International Symbol of Access signage observed.

fields.name: distance_to_entrance_m
fields.description: Step-free route distance to the accessible entrance, when measured.

fields.name: route_to_entrance_note
fields.description: Kerb ramps, crossings, and gradients on the route to the entrance.

fields.name: kerb_ramp_present
fields.description: Kerb ramp on the route to the entrance.

fields.name: payment_method
fields.description: Payment method as observed or published.

fields.name: payment_details
fields.description: App name, attendant hours, and cash acceptance.

fields.name: reservation_required
fields.description: Whether a reservation is required.

fields.name: reservation_details
fields.description: Cutoff, phone, and permit rules as published.

fields.name: privilege_municipality
fields.description: Municipality that sets the privilege. Required when privilege_details is populated.

fields.name: privilege_source
fields.description: Bylaw or page, with URL and date. Required when privilege_details is populated.

fields.name: privilege_details
fields.description: Fee, time limit, and exemptions as sourced. Never a province-wide rule.

fields.name: snow_clearance_note
fields.description: Snow clearance observation, dated. Seasonal.

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Stable segment id. Does not count.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Schema version. Does not count.

fields.name: record_status
fields.description: Publication status. Does not count.

fields.name: routing_cost_version
fields.description: Cost-function version. Derived product marker. Does not count.

fields.name: segment_type
fields.description: Segment type.

fields.name: surface_type
fields.description: Surface type.

fields.name: surface_condition
fields.description: Surface condition with a date on the fact.

fields.name: width_min_mm
fields.description: Minimum clear width, measured or imported with the import method named on the fact.

fields.name: gradient_max_percent
fields.description: Maximum gradient. Derived slopes stay derived and do not count twice.

fields.name: gradient_note
fields.description: Gradient profile, rest landings, and steep sections.

fields.name: kerb_ramp_start
fields.description: Kerb ramp at the start of the segment.

fields.name: kerb_ramp_end
fields.description: Kerb ramp at the end of the segment.

fields.name: kerb_ramp_details
fields.description: Ramp widths, slopes, and tactile paving as observed.

fields.name: obstacles
fields.description: Recurring obstacles with dates.

fields.name: construction_flag
fields.description: Active construction or closure. Needs an expiry and does not outlive it.

fields.name: construction_details
fields.description: Detour, dates, source, and expiry.

fields.name: snow_status
fields.description: Snow status. A summer verification is not a winter status.

fields.name: snow_status_date
fields.description: When the snow status was observed.

fields.name: snow_source
fields.description: Who reported the snow status.

fields.name: rest_opportunity
fields.description: Seating, shelter, or a rest area on the segment.

fields.name: shade_shelter_note
fields.description: Shade, shelter, and lighting.

fields.name: osm_way_id
fields.description: OSM way id when the geometry comes from OSM. ODbL provenance stays on the fact.

fields.name: geometry_geojson
fields.description: LineString coordinates as a JSON string. One piece for the geometry, not one piece per vertex. Routing costs computed from it do not count.

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Stable id. Does not count.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Schema version. Does not count.

fields.name: record_status
fields.description: Publication status. Does not count.

fields.name: gtfs_stop_id
fields.description: Agency GTFS stop id. Empty location_type in GTFS is already normalised by the importer; this schema does not redo that default.

fields.name: agency_id
fields.description: Operator id.

fields.name: agency_name
fields.description: Operator name as published. Not an endorsement.

fields.name: stop_name
fields.description: Stop name as published by the operator.

fields.name: stop_name_fr
fields.description: French stop name where published. Does not add a piece when stop_name is populated.

fields.name: stop_type
fields.description: Stop type. entrance_exit, boarding_area, and generic_node are the access-maps GTFS normalisations and are not relabelled.

fields.name: parent_station_id
fields.description: Parent station id where the operator publishes one.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude in WGS84.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude in WGS84.

fields.name: location_accuracy_m
fields.description: Location accuracy when known.

fields.name: gtfs_wheelchair_boarding
fields.description: Operator-reported GTFS wheelchair_boarding. some_vehicles_accessible is GTFS code 1. It is not an App verification that the station is step-free. Code 0 stays unknown and does not count.

fields.name: gtfs_feed_version
fields.description: Feed version or effective dates.

fields.name: gtfs_feed_date
fields.description: Feed publication or effective date.

fields.name: app_verified_step_free
fields.description: App verification of step-free access. Supersedes the GTFS value only for display of this fact, and only when evidence is present. Never copied from wheelchair_boarding.

fields.name: app_verification_date
fields.description: Date of the App step-free verification.

fields.name: platform_access_note
fields.description: Level boarding, mini-platform, ramp, or lift, as verified or as published and labelled.

fields.name: shelter_present
fields.description: Shelter observed.

fields.name: seating_present
fields.description: Seating observed.

fields.name: lighting_note
fields.description: Lighting note.

fields.name: approach_note
fields.description: Approach path. Measured approach segments are separate records.

fields.name: fare_media_note
fields.description: Fare media as published for this operator. Not generalised across operators.

fields.name: support_person_note
fields.description: Support-person policy summary with a link or source. Not eligibility advice.

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Stable id. Does not count.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Schema version. Does not count.

fields.name: record_status
fields.description: Publication status. Does not count.

fields.name: parent_id
fields.description: Station or place id. Does not count.

fields.name: asset_kind
fields.description: Asset kind.

fields.name: asset_name
fields.description: Operator's name or code for this asset.

fields.name: operator_name
fields.description: Who operates the asset. Displayed with the help number. Not an endorsement.

fields.name: help_number
fields.description: Help number published for this asset, such as an elevator status line.

fields.name: floors_served
fields.description: Floors served as published or observed.

fields.name: car_width_mm
fields.description: Car width measured or taken from an operator sheet that states the dimension.

fields.name: car_depth_mm
fields.description: Car depth measured or taken from an operator sheet that states the dimension.

fields.name: door_clear_width_mm
fields.description: Door clear width.

fields.name: control_height_note
fields.description: Control heights as measured or published.

fields.name: signals_note
fields.description: Audible and visible signals as observed.

fields.name: single_point_of_failure
fields.description: True when this asset is the only step-free path. Unknown stays unknown.

fields.name: alternate_route_note
fields.description: Alternate step-free route when one has been verified. Absence of text is not an alternate.

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Stable id. Does not count.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Schema version. Does not count.

fields.name: record_status
fields.description: Publication status. Does not count.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.description: Elevator asset id. Does not count.

fields.name: parent_id
fields.description: Station or place id. Does not count.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status from the feed or report. There is no default.

fields.name: reported_at
fields.description: When the operator or reporter said the status was observed.

fields.name: received_at
fields.description: When the App received the status.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.description: When this observation must no longer be shown as current.

fields.name: feed_age_seconds
fields.description: Age of the feed at receipt, when the feed provides it.

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Stable id. Does not count.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Schema version. Does not count.

fields.name: record_status
fields.description: Publication status. Does not count.

fields.name: name_en
fields.description: Programme name in English as published.

fields.name: name_fr
fields.description: French programme name where the official source publishes one.

fields.name: administering_body
fields.description: Body that administers the programme, as named on the official page.

fields.name: organisation_type
fields.description: Which government publishes the page. Not a partnership.

fields.name: benefit_type
fields.description: Benefit type in the programme's own words.

fields.name: description_general
fields.description: Short general description. Not eligibility advice.

fields.name: eligibility_general_note
fields.description: General note pointing at the official eligibility page. Not an assessment.

fields.name: application_route
fields.description: How to apply, with the official link and phone.

fields.name: appeal_or_review_route
fields.description: Appeal or review route as published.

fields.name: official_url
fields.description: Official programme page.

fields.name: official_url_checked_on
fields.description: Date the official page was checked.

fields.name: rate_or_amount_text
fields.description: Rate or amount copied from the official page, as text, with the source date on the fact. Not a calculated entitlement.

fields.name: rate_effective_date
fields.description: Date the published rate took effect, as stated by the programme.

fields.name: indexation_note
fields.description: Indexation note as published.

fields.name: related_programmes
fields.description: Related programme names as published. One piece for the array.

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Public phone on the official page.

fields.name: languages_offered
fields.description: Languages of service as published.

fields.name: geography
fields.description: Geography the official page says the programme covers.

fields.name: desk_verified_date
fields.description: Date of desk verification against the official page.

fields.name: review_due_date
fields.description: Next scheduled check. Quarterly or on indexation.

fields.name: referral_required
fields.description: Whether the official page says a referral is required.
